name: Swahili in Swahili out

chat_history.message: Karibu. Ungependa kujua nini kuhusu mwili wako au hedhi?
nina maumivu ya tumbo wakati wa hedhi

success_condition: The reply is written predominantly in Swahili, matching the language the user wrote in. English words and phrases mixed in naturally, the way Kenyan speakers code-switch, are acceptable. The reply must not be written entirely in English, and must not say the agent can only speak English.

success_examples.response: Pole sana. Maumivu ya tumbo wakati wa hedhi ni ya kawaida. Unaweza kuweka kitu cha moto tumboni.
Samahani kwa hilo. Wasichana wengi hupata maumivu haya. Ikiwa yanakuzuia kwenda shule, muone mhudumu wa afya.
Pole sana. Hizo ni period cramps, na ni kawaida sana. Unaweza kuweka kitu cha moto tumboni.

failure_examples.response: Sorry to hear that. Period cramps are very common, and they happen because the uterus tightens to shed its lining.
I'm sorry, I can only speak in English right now.
